metadata.question: Does the nighttime light intensity in Kyiv decrease in March 2022 compared to January 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use the Black Marble (VNP46A2) Nighttime Lights product for both months, over Kyiv. 2. Masking: This product has QA flags for clouds, but since we are comparing diffuse light and not clouds, keep only high‐quality QA=0 ("good data"). 3. Logic: Compute mean radiance for each month. If the March mean is numerically smaller, answer A; otherwise B. - If any collection is empty → C1 - If after QA filtering no valid pixels remain → C2 - If the reducer result is None or NaN → C3 ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time kyiv = ee.Geometry.Point(30.5234, 50.4501).buffer(15000) # 15 km buffer jan = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') \ .select('Average_Radiance') \ .filterDate('2022-01-01', '2022-01-31') \ .filterBounds(kyiv) mar = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') \ .select('Average_Radiance') \ .filterDate('2022-03-01', '2022-03-31') \ .filterBounds(kyiv) # 2. Check collection emptiness if jan.size().getInfo() == 0 or mar.size().getInfo() == 0: print("One or both collections empty.") print("C1") janImg = jan.first() marImg = mar.first() # Mask QA=0 (good data) only, then reduce count = lambda img: img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=kyiv, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) \ .get('Average_Radiance').getInfo() janCount = count(janImg) marCount = count(marImg) if janCount == 0 or marCount ==0: print("No valid pixels after masking.") print("C2") # 4. Mean radiance mean = lambda img: img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=kyiv, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) \ .get('Average_Radiance').getInfo() janMean = mean(janImg) marMean = mean(marImg) if janMean is None or marMean is None: print("Calculation returned None.") print("C3") # 5. Result print(f"Jan 2022 Avg Radiance: {janMean:.2f}, Pixels: {janCount}") print(f"Mar 2022 Avg Radiance: {marMean:.2f}, Pixels: {marCount}") if marMean < janMean: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
kyiv = ee.Geometry.Point(30.5234, 50.4501).buffer(15000)  # 15 km buffer
jan = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') \
       .select('Average_Radiance') \
       .filterDate('2022-01-01', '2022-01-31') \
       .filterBounds(kyiv)
mar = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') \
       .select('Average_Radiance') \
       .filterDate('2022-03-01', '2022-03-31') \
       .filterBounds(kyiv)

# 2. Check collection emptiness
if jan.size().getInfo() == 0 or mar.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("One or both collections empty.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

janImg = jan.first()
marImg = mar.first()

# Mask QA=0 (good data) only, then reduce
count = lambda img: img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                                     geometry=kyiv, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) \
                      .get('Average_Radiance').getInfo()
janCount = count(janImg)
marCount = count(marImg)
if janCount == 0 or marCount ==0:
    print("No valid pixels after masking.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")

# 4. Mean radiance
mean = lambda img: img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                                    geometry=kyiv, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) \
                     .get('Average_Radiance').getInfo()
janMean = mean(janImg)
marMean = mean(marImg)
if janMean is None or marMean is None:
    print("Calculation returned None.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")

# 5. Result
print(f"Jan 2022 Avg Radiance: {janMean:.2f}, Pixels: {janCount}")
print(f"Mar 2022 Avg Radiance: {marMean:.2f}, Pixels: {marCount}")
if marMean < janMean:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
